rule_text: A clinical decision has been made to order the DCISionRT Test as part of routine patient care
Histologically confirmed ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) in a single breast (LCIS or other benign disease allowed)
Patient must be consented within 120 days after surgery
Eligible for, or have already received, breast conserving surgery
Eligible to receive radiation and/or systemic treatment
Patient is female
Patient age is greater than 25 years
Patient must be able to provide informed consent
Patient tissue is insufficient to generate DCISionRT test results
Required DCISionRT input 'age' is missing
Required DCISionRT input 'tumor size' is missing
Required DCISionRT input 'margin status' is missing
Required DCISionRT input 'palpability' is missing
Patient has invasive breast cancer
Evidence of invasive breast cancer in the ipsilateral or contralateral breast
Microinvasion present
Lymph node involvement present
Paget's disease of the nipple present
Patient has already been surgically treated with a mastectomy for primary DCIS
Patient has prior in situ or invasive breast cancer
